description: Build an unsigned smart contract deployment transaction for the Klever blockchain. Provide either wasmPath (preferred — reads the file server-side) or wasmHex. Returns the unsigned transaction for client-side signing. The MCP server NEVER handles private keys.

initArgs.description: Optional base64-encoded init arguments for the contract constructor.

network.description: Network to use. Options: "mainnet", "testnet", "devnet", "local". Defaults to server default (mainnet).

wasmHex.description: Smart contract WASM bytecode as a hex-encoded string. Use wasmPath instead for large contracts.

wasmPath.description: Absolute path to the compiled WASM file (preferred over wasmHex to avoid loading large binaries into AI context).

name: deploy_sc
